about: The looks a site's staff may pick, as both backends must read them: LOOKS in .env (Node, namedLooks in server/config.ts) and 'looks' in config.php (PHP, SiteLooks). Replayed by tests/unit/looks-settings.test.ts and php/tests/ConfigTest.php, against `known`: the looks a release has (src/shared/looks.ts, schema/shared.json), here two, since the site's order and its first can only be seen with two. `env` is the variable's value (null: not set), `php` the key's value (null: not set); a row without one of them is the other backend's alone. `looks` is what the site offers, in its order: the first is what a new flyer starts in. A refusal names the setting and the looks there are, never its value (docs/prompts/looks-seam.md, M3).

accepted.name: not set: the first look alone
two, in the site's order: a new flyer starts in the first
spaces and a stray comma, as typed in .env

refused.name: a look this release does not have
a look's name in other letters
a look's name with spaces round it
